description: Fraction of generated molecules whose metal centre matches the expected d-block coordination geometry (Pt_II square-planar, Pt_IV octahedral, Ir_0/Ir_I/Ir_III). Per Lnnard-Berg 1995 + Reedijk 1987 + Miessler 2014 d-block geometry tables.
unit: ratio (0-1); higher = better d-block geometry compliance
scope: Lambda + CFM evaluations (metal-seeded runs); 0.0 on no-metal seeds or no Pt/Ir present
lit_anchors: Lippard & Berg 1995 Principles of Bioinorganic Chemistry
math_prior: compliance_rate(smis) = (#smis where coord_geometry(M(metal)) matches expected_table[M]) / (#smis with metal present); 0.0 fallback if no metal; expected geometries: Pt_II=square_planar (4 ligands, 90 deg), Pt_IV=octahedral (6 ligands), Ir_0=linear (2), Ir_I=square_planar (4), Ir_III=octahedral (6)

measurements.caveat: single Pt_II scaffold + single metal seed; singleton collapse to cisplatin itself; no diversity test

measurements.value: smoke-only: Pt_II square-planar detection + scaffold auto-detection

aggregate.lit_target_targetdiff: TargetDiff does NOT have metal prior; closest analog = scaffold validity rate; gap = positive (we add d-block check SOTA lacks)

verdict: DESIGN+1-PILOT — Phase-3G metal_coord_probe module + Phase-4 dispatch integration shipped; single 5x1 cisplatin+all-5 pilot lifts 0.0->1.0 but is a singleton collapse (n_distinct=1), NOT a true positive result. Honest framing: measurement = 1.0 but with n_distinct=1 the metric trivially passes on the seed itself. Full 10x3 rotation (3 metal seeds x 10 pockets x 3 random seeds) blocked by GPU outage (per wf_gpu_diag_fix) and by F2(a) MetalLigandExchange SMARTS rule TODO-29.
singleton_collapse_warning: Round-12 10x3 results: all 30 cells collapse to single candidate [NH2][Pt]([NH2])([Cl])[Cl] (n_distinct=1) when --metal-seed cisplatin + --click-rules all-5; the metal_compliance=1.0 measurement is HONEST but TRIVIAL — passes because the seed itself is Pt_II square-planar. Real non-degenerate compliance verification requires F2(a) + n_simulations>=1000 + multiple metal seeds.
